correctness.rationale: On the precisely defined smooth genus-five characteristic-seven locus, the explicit Cartier coefficient matrix has determinant -9ab³F and a 4x4 minor -3b³c⁴. The c=0 matrix is a generalized permutation matrix with rank three exactly on a²+b=0. Therefore all three strata and the a-number ceiling follow. Eisenstein at b proves irreducibility of F, Jacobian-gradient analysis singles out Gamma, and a unit square-root coordinate change proves the transverse A4 normal form. Exact symbolic polynomial-ring calculation and independent enumeration of 343 F7 triples both pass; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The four-monomial deformation of a published natural genus-five family gives a complete parameter-space a-number classification. The irreducible Hasse component is cuspidal along exactly the enhanced a-number stratum, and its transverse A4 type is a structural nonordinary phenomenon not a single isolated example or arbitrary numerical slice. This is valuable geometric information without claiming full moduli or 7-rank results.
